cues.text: A 63-year-old man comes in with bowel symptoms.
He has had diarrhoea for a month: a change in bowel habit lasting more than three weeks,
He also has occasional abdominal pain,
These are common symptoms of colorectal cancer: here, a rectal carcinoma.
The risk rises with age; the median age at diagnosis of rectal cancer is 63.
Other warning signs: dark stools, weight loss and fatigue.
